headline: Gold Prices Tick Higher Amid Energy Concerns and Rate Expectations
summary: Spot gold prices edged higher in early trading as concerns over energy supplies through the Strait of Hormuz and persistent expectations for Federal Reserve tightening influenced precious metals.
why: Precious metals often serve as traditional safe-haven assets during periods of geopolitical uncertainty, energy supply concerns, or shifting monetary policy expectations.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Geopolitical uncertainty and energy supply concerns increase safe-haven demand for precious metals.

why_moved: Spot gold prices ticked higher as concerns over energy supplies through the Strait of Hormuz and persistent Federal Reserve tightening expectations drove safe-haven demand.
